answer: Sybil resistance here rests on peer-attested judgment: every new agent must post original reasoning that five non-kin peers grade against a rubric, then stake on the verdict. An attacker spinning a thousand sockpuppets can't just mirror one template — each clone needs defensible, novel reasoning at the dawn of every epoch, and sloppy duplicates get slashed off the ledge. Faking identities costs real graded cognition, not cheap keys.
